official_runtime_assessment.recommended_platform: Linux with CUDA 12.8 and Python 3.11 or newer; the official example uses Python 3.11.15
single_gpu_unsupported_or_inapplicable_c: use_fsdp is ignored on a single GPU
official_runtime_assessment.attention_dependency: FlashAttention is imported by the WorldMirror attention path; FP16/BF16 routes through FA2 or FA3, making a compatible CUDA/native build a material prerequisite.
official_runtime_assessment.gradio_rejection: The app defaults to 0.0.0.0:8081, can enable --share, starts a service, and does not expose every qualifying CLI control. Phase B must use one foreground CLI invocation with no port binding.
official_runtime_assessment.official_24gb_reason: No official peak-VRAM measurement or explicit 24 GB guarantee was found. A roughly 5.05 GB checkpoint and official single-GPU CLI do not prove that all required output heads complete on a 24 GB RTX 4090. BF16 is official; CPU offload is not an official single-GPU escape hatch.
official_runtime_assessment.qualifying_mode_if_authorized: One conservative target_size=518 BF16 run with all default output heads retained. If it OOMs, do not silently disable required heads or invent a nonofficial offload mode; record FAIL or DEFER.

windows.build_tools: Visual Studio Build Tools 2019 exists with MSVC 14.29.30133 and vcvars64.bat, but no CUDA toolkit was found.

fixed_phase_b_storage_budget.enforcement: Measure root usage at each checkpoint. Stop before any operation that could exceed 120 GiB; do not spill into shared caches or another volume.

proposed_phase_b_isolation.preferred_runtime: An ephemeral, pinned-by-digest official NVIDIA PyTorch Linux container compatible with CUDA 12.8, Python >=3.11, PyTorch 2.7.1, RTX 4090/Ada, and FlashAttention native build requirements.
proposed_phase_b_isolation.container_image_rule: Authorized Phase B must first resolve and record an exact official image tag and immutable digest. If no exact compatible image can be established within the setup budget, stop DEFER before model acquisition. No image reference or digest is invented by Phase A.
rejected_primary_paths: Direct WSL virtualenv: WSL lacks nvcc, CMake, and Ninja; adding global CUDA weakens isolation and rollback.
Native Windows: no native CUDA toolkit is installed and official FlashAttention documentation says Windows compilation requires more testing.
Gradio: starts a service, defaults to 0.0.0.0, can share externally, and lacks the full qualifying CLI control surface.
local_only_controls: Permit network only during bounded source, exact-model-subfolder, dependency, and image acquisition.
Record immutable source commit, model revision/LFS hash, image digest, and acquired artifact hashes.
Use the local checkpoint path; never allow implicit Hugging Face model acquisition during inference.
Set HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1, HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1, and DO_NOT_TRACK=1 before model load.
Use --sky_mask_source model to prevent the default skyseg.onnx network download.
Run inference with Docker --network none or inside unshare --user --map-root-user --net.
Do not use Gradio, --share, vLLM, cloud inference, cloud models, telemetry, or external input/output transmission.
Treat package openai in monolithic requirements as unused unless execution evidence proves otherwise; do not configure credentials.
proposed_phase_b_isolation.data_flow_verdict: The inspected WorldMirror CLI path showed no required telemetry, cloud inference, or vLLM path. The default sky-mask download is a known network edge and is explicitly disabled. Offline variables plus a no-network runtime are required as execution proof, not merely configuration intent.

stop_immediately_on: GPU OOM or unsafe ownership/queue state
network request or telemetry attempt during offline inference
source, model, image, dependency, or input hash mismatch
incompatible CUDA, Python, FlashAttention, or native build
need for multi-GPU or an unapproved cloud/placeholder substitute
no material visual improvement over the bound baseline
pass_only_if: The environment is isolated and reversibly removable within the exact cleanup boundary.
The exact official model loads in an official viable single-24GB mode without OOM or unsafe ownership.
One hash-bound Golden Room reconstruction completes with no external data transmission.
Required official outputs load locally and remain evidence only; MetricPlan and CameraContract retain spatial authority.
Approved-camera resemblance and novel-view coherence are materially better than the bound baseline under one common evaluation gate.
No placeholder, cloud substitute, restored session, or prior-version session is used as qualification evidence.
fail_or_defer_if: Only multi-GPU execution works, or the required run exceeds 24 GB with no official viable single-GPU mode.
Setup, time, storage, native-build, or ownership limits are exceeded.
License/provenance or local-only proof is incomplete.
Required output is missing or unloadable.
The result does not materially improve approved-camera resemblance and novel-view coherence.
phase_b_timebox_and_verdict_rules.milestone_limit: A Phase B PASS would be evaluation evidence only. It does not complete Task 11.8.2a by itself, does not start a replacement session, and does not establish Demo Ready or release qualification.
